technology_name: BACK-STEPPING CONTROLLER BASED DROOP-FREE CONTROL SYSTEM FOR PARALLEL DC DISTRIBUTION WITH IMPROVED STABILITY AND TRANSIENT RESPONSE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Smart Grid Architecture / Power Flow Control
problem_solved: Parallel DC power distribution links experience poor load sharing and voltage droops under heavy fluctuations when managed by standard droop controllers.
description: An intelligent droop-free parallel power distribution network control architecture running a non-linear mathematical back-stepping controller loop that actively modulates inverter duty cycles matching a centralized Lyapunov stability equation.
applications: Electric vehicle charging infrastructure, localized residential DC microgrids, server data center power distribution blocks, and aerospace electrical grids.
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
